components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per card that moves the work forward: Approve, Send answer, Pair.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg>Approve</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #0a0c14; color: #fff; font: 620 15.5px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .22), 0 10px 26px -12px rgb(10 12 20 / .7); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The counter-action next to a primary: Deny, Go to inbox.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M6.5 6.5l11 11"/><path d="M17.5 6.5l-11 11"/></svg>Deny</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .14); border-radius: 999px; background: #f4f5f9; color: #0a0c14; font: 620 15.5px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e9ebf2; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Request Card
components.description: A request waiting on you: kind, where, heat timer, literal proof, decision. The edge turns while it waits.
components.html:
>_Claude needs approvalapi-server · dev@laptop4m 16s
pnpm --filter api-server db:migrate
components.css: .ds-req { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .14); border-radius: 26px; background: radial-gradient(120% 90px at 50% 0, rgb(255 138 61 / .12), transparent), #fff; box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -28px rgb(255 138 61 / .55); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-req header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-req header span:nth-child(2) { flex: 1; display: grid; } .ds-req small { color: #4b5266; font-size: 13px; } .ds-req-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgb(255 138 61 / .16); color: #b4410f; font-family: monospace; } .ds-req-timer { height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgb(255 138 61 / .15); color: #9a5b00; font: 600 13px 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-req pre { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: #f6f7fa; border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .08); font: 13px/1.6 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: One session in an inset list: orb, project, agent and age, state word and two-line preview.
components.css: .ds-list { border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .08); border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 74px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(10 12 20 / .04); } .ds-orb { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0874b3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(8 116 179 / .16); align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 7px; } .ds-row-main { flex: 1; display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-row-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-row-top b { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-top small { color: #646b7f; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-row-sub { color: #4b5266; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-row-sub em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; color: #0874b3; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Pairing code and phone name fields.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 54px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .14); border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; color: #0a0c14; font: 16px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5ee7ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(94 231 255 / .15); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #646b7f; }

components.name: User Bubble
components.description: Your prompt or phone reply in the conversation.
components.html: Move the billing webhooks onto the job queue and keep retries idempotent.
components.css: .ds-bubble { max-width: 86%; margin-left: auto; padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 22px 22px 6px 22px; background: #e2e6f3; color: #0a0c14; font: 15px/1.5 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mute duration and theme: a track with a sliding thumb.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 4px; border-radius: 18px; background: #e6e8ef; border: 1px solid rgb(12 16 32 / .08); } .ds-seg button { height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #4b5266; font: 560 14px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #fff; color: #0a0c14; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -4px rgb(20 28 60 / .15); }

narrative.overview: AgentWatch answers one question first, "does anything need me?", in a single sentence at the top of the inbox. Blocked work sits directly under it, each request carrying its exact proof and its decision at thumb height. Everything else is a quiet, grouped list, and a session reads like a modern chat. The craft bar is current premium software: dark-first near-black blue under a soft top light, frosted chrome, generous radii, Geist type and an inverted pill as the one primary action, with a full light twin.
keyCharacteristics: One status sentence answers the glance; the sky behind it changes temperature with it.
Waiting requests have a live edge that heats from amber to red as the wait grows.
State is carried by a word, an orb shape and a colour, never colour alone.
Agent text is rendered Markdown with highlighted code, never raw text.
Every control is a standard one: buttons, lists, segmented controls, a text field.

rules.name: The Warm-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Nothing decorative is warm. When nothing waits on you, the screen has no orange or red, and the sky is cool.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state has a word and an orb behaviour; every decision has an icon and a label; online and offline are a filled dot versus a ring.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks something you could paste into a terminal or that measures time. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Glass-Is-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Blur appears only where content really scrolls under something: the top bar and the banners. Cards are never glass.

dos: Do lead every screen with the answer: the status sentence, or the session's state in the bar.
Do show the exact command or file before any decision.
Do keep warm colours for waiting, and let the sky cool when nothing is.
Do render agent text as Markdown, and flatten it to plain text for previews.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass on cards, or coloured side borders.
Don't add brand colour to state, or state colour to decoration.
Don't make agent-provided links clickable, or render agent HTML.
Don't add equal-weight dashboard cards. The inbox is a sentence, a stack and lists.
